name: ninfier-ui
description: Native Linux desktop UI (Tauri 2) for the NInfer local LLM inference engine: engine configuration, model management, and streaming chat.

scripts.desktop:build: pnpm build && cargo build --manifest-path desktop/Cargo.toml -p ninfier-studio
scripts.desktop:build:tray: pnpm build && cargo build --manifest-path desktop/Cargo.toml -p ninfier-studio --features tray
scripts.desktop:run:tray: NINFIER_STUDIO_DATA=$PWD/data cargo run --manifest-path desktop/Cargo.toml -p ninfier-studio --features tray
scripts.desktop:bundle: pnpm build && pnpm tauri build --manifest-path desktop/Cargo.toml --features tray --bundles deb appimage
